description: Read one joseki run's row by run id: status (running/awaiting_user/completed/failed), the card and WBS it executes, its session and flow, the last submitted step, typed failure detail, and reconciler attempt count. found=False when the id is unknown.
embedding_description: Check the status of a single platform-driven joseki run by its run id: is the run still executing, parked awaiting a user, completed, or failed — and with what typed failure detail. The per-run observability read for callers polling a run they started with run_joseki. Distinct from list_joseki_runs (the bounded multi-run listing) and get_authored_joseki (the CARD's lifecycle row, not a run).
